archetypes.name: ship-state
archetypes.rationale: Large new Python driver introduces state-machine, idempotency, and exit-routing risks beyond the static panel.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the new python/ship.py driver as an end-to-end state machine. Check stage ordering, re-entry behavior, OOS gating, CI loop transitions, merge/postmerge handoff, JSON result fields, and bash-compatible exit-code mapping. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: bash-parity
archetypes.rationale: The diff depends on preserving live bash behavior while adding a dormant Python path.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the Python path and skills/implement/SKILL.md selector against the documented bash ship-pr and finalize contracts. Look for drift in argv/env handling, skip branches, outcome routing, state-file usage, and Step 18 teardown assumptions. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: runlogs
archetypes.rationale: State-file-less run-log flushing and manifest ordering are high-risk acceptance criteria.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review python/run_logs.py and its callers for state-file-less pre-push and post-merge behavior. Verify repo-root cwd requirements, no-logs handling, manifest status and pr_number ordering, final-report timing, and avoidance of duplicate or skipped flushes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: finalize-flow
archetypes.rationale: The new finalize implementation can affect local branches, tmpdir cleanup, issue renames, and stall preservation.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect python/finalize.py for postbump, postmerge, teardown, session guards, stalled-run preservation, issue rename behavior, and local cleanup semantics. Pay special attention to no post-merge commits, no status=done writes in postmerge, and safe handling of repo-unavailable, forked, draft, merge-false, and bail paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: ci-handback
archetypes.rationale: CI monitor integration must preserve autonomous fixer handback and rebase-loop semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on CI monitor loop integration in python/ship.py and related tests. Check counter updates, goto_rebase handling, transient and needs-user outcomes, failed_run_id propagation, and whether first-fixer or CI-exhausted paths provide enough information for the SKILL branch without ship-pr-state.sh. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-gate
archetypes.rationale: CI and Makefile wiring changes can silently drop or misplace parity coverage.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review Makefile, workflow requirements, and the new/updated pytest files as an integration gate. Verify test-merge-parity is wired into the intended shard, pytest will be installed where needed, tests are not accidentally skipped, and coverage matches the plan’s critical acceptance points. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
